descriptions.negligible: Steady-state error is negligible relative to the noise floor (SNR < 1).
descriptions.marginal: Steady-state error is slightly visible but near the noise floor (1 ≤ SNR ≤ 3).
descriptions.significant: Steady-state error is significant relative to noise (SNR > 3). Consider adjusting Ki.

stats.meanHelp: Confirms the held position; compare it with the target
stats.stdHelp: Quantifies the position noise floor objectively. Lower is better.
stats.p2pHelp: Captures spike outliers and the maximum deviation range.
stats.snrHelp: Checks whether steady-state error is significant relative to noise. SNR < 1 is negligible; SNR > 3 is significant.
stats.note: Statistical metrics analyze the selected position samples. Use them after the robot has settled at a static target to evaluate holding performance and the noise floor.

help.title: How to Use the ZN Procedure
help.step1: Set Ki = 0.0000 and Kd = 0.0000 in the controls above.
help.step2: Send a step target command, such as t1,45.00.
help.step3: Raise Kp slowly until the output reaches a stable, sustained, constant-amplitude oscillation.
help.step4: Record the Kp at this point as the ultimate gain Ku.
help.step5: Drag over 2–3 complete oscillation cycles on the chart.
help.step6: The advisor calculates the ultimate period Tu and recommended gains.
help.step7: Choose a tuning rule and click each highlighted coefficient to apply it to the device.

ControlPanel.kpTooltip: Proportional gain: responds to current position error. Higher values can speed up response but may cause overshoot.
ControlPanel.kiTooltip: Integral gain: accumulates position error to reduce steady-state offset.
ControlPanel.ki2Tooltip: J2 uses P+D control for residual CTC tracking error. Ki is disabled to prevent stepper saturation and integrator windup.
ControlPanel.kdTooltip: Derivative gain: responds to error rate of change to damp oscillation and stabilize motion.
ControlPanel.microstepTooltip: Divides motor steps into smaller increments for smoother, quieter, more precise motion.

step0.title: Welcome to SCARA HMI
step0.description: Tour the controls and run your first trajectory.

step1.title: Connect SCARA Robot
step1.description: Select a COM port to connect the SCARA controller over Web Serial.

step2.title: Settings & Diagnostics Menu
step2.description: Set angle units, ghost trail opacity, and keyboard shortcuts. Download diagnostic graphs and raw telemetry as ZIP files.

step3.description: Click Pick Point in the XY Trace header to select a target.

step4.title: Step 2: Select a Target
step4.description: Click inside the blue workspace arcs to set the target coordinates.

step5.title: Step 3: Check Settings
step5.description: Check the Xf and Yf target fields. Adjust J1/J2 PID gains and CTC feedforward blends here.

step6.title: Step 4: Run the Trajectory
step6.description: Click ▶ Run to move the arm, or click Next to simulate.

step7.title: Live Serial Terminal
step7.description: Open the terminal at the bottom to view serial commands and telemetry.

step8.title: Emergency Stop & Resume
step8.description: In an emergency, stop motion and motor output. Resume only when safe to restore motor control.

step9.title: Tour Complete
step9.description: You have set a target and run a trajectory. Explore the charts and motor parameters next.

AdvTuner.title: Advanced Controller Parameters
AdvTuner.subtitle: Tune trajectory limits, deadbands, and hold modes on the ESP32.
AdvTuner.disconnected: Disconnected: Connect serial port to sync and tune parameters.
AdvTuner.offlineWarning: Showing offline defaults. Connect serial and sync to load hardware parameters.
AdvTuner.vmaxTooltip: Maximum Cartesian line velocity in m/s (clamped in trajectory planner).
AdvTuner.ddthTooltip: Maximum clamping limit for joint acceleration in rad/s² for system safety.
AdvTuner.cfreqTooltip: Execution frequency of the controller loop on ESP32 in Hz.
AdvTuner.idecayTooltip: J1 integrator decay coefficient (0.0 to 1.0), used to prevent integral windup.
AdvTuner.u1maxTooltip: Maximum J1 controller output (PWM saturation limit).
AdvTuner.kv1Tooltip: Velocity feedforward gain (fraction per rad/s): vff = kv1 × desired_velocity (dTheta1_d).
AdvTuner.vffmaxTooltip: Maximum absolute fraction for velocity feedforward (fraction of U1_MAX).
AdvTuner.vffdvTooltip: Maximum per-tick change for vff (fraction of U1_MAX).
AdvTuner.taunomTooltip: Normalization parameter for feedforward scaling on Joint 1 Computed Torque Control.
AdvTuner.m22refTooltip: Normalization parameter for inertia feedforward scaling on Joint 2 Computed Torque Control.
AdvTuner.tdDesc: TD replaces the IIR filter. r is bandwidth (rad/s); higher values respond faster but add noise. h = 3×DT is read-only and set by firmware.
AdvTuner.td1rTooltip: Bandwidth parameter r for Joint 1 Tracking Differentiator (rad/s). Larger = more responsive, smaller = smoother.
AdvTuner.td2rTooltip: Bandwidth parameter r for Joint 2 Tracking Differentiator (rad/s).
AdvTuner.tdStepTooltip: h = 3×DT, calculated by firmware from loop frequency (cfreq). Read-only.
AdvTuner.pwmDbTooltip: Friction deadband threshold (PWM units 0-254) below which motor won't rotate.
AdvTuner.errdzTooltip: Errors below this threshold (rad) are treated as zero. This keeps potentiometer noise from driving the integrator or causing corrections smaller than the motor deadband.
AdvTuner.ifreezeTooltip: When |e1| is below this threshold (rad) while the motor is active, the integrator decays. This limits windup through the deadband and reduces kicks and jitter near the setpoint.
AdvTuner.fztTooltip: Control effort below this fraction of U1_MAX is treated as zero (PWM = 0), reducing motor chatter from noise.
AdvTuner.fztkTooltip: Kickstart threshold as a fraction of fzt (0.10 = 10%). Applied during trajectory acceleration when enabled.
AdvTuner.kspenTooltip: Toggle reduced fractional threshold during trajectory acceleration.
AdvTuner.dbmenTooltip: When enabled, PWM deadband amplitude is scaled while moving (dbEngageScale).
AdvTuner.dbensTooltip: Scale applied to the computed PWM deadband during movement (0.1 - 1.0).
AdvTuner.dbenTooltip: Position error threshold (radians) below which Joint 1 enters Hold Mode.
AdvTuner.dbrelTooltip: Position error threshold (radians) above which Joint 1 exits/releases Hold Mode.
AdvTuner.dbvelTooltip: Joint velocity threshold (rad/s) below which Joint 1 enters Hold Mode.
AdvTuner.hskpTooltip: Proportional gain (Kp) multiplier scaling factor applied in Hold Mode.
AdvTuner.hskdTooltip: Derivative gain (Kd) multiplier scaling factor applied in Hold Mode.
AdvTuner.db2enTooltip: J2 position error (rad) below which the stepper enters Hold Mode and disables pulses.
AdvTuner.db2relTooltip: J2 position error (rad) above which the stepper exits Hold Mode and resumes control.
AdvTuner.queueNote: Next trajectory starts automatically once current settles.
AdvTuner.ki2gTooltip: Activation gate for Joint 2 integral action (radians).

runMetrics.title: Run metrics
runMetrics.aiTooltip: Accuracy Index (AI): 1 − MCTE/D. 100% = perfect path tracking.
runMetrics.epsMaxTooltip: Maximum Cross Tracking Error (ε_max): worst lateral deviation in the run.
runMetrics.mcteTooltip: Mean CTE (MCTE): path-integrated lateral area divided by path length.
runMetrics.rmsAteTooltip: RMS Along-Track Error: quadratic average of lead/lag without sign cancellation.
runMetrics.reTooltip: Error Bias (R_ε): >50% Delay → raise Kp/Ki/Kff; >50% Shape → tune Kd or check mechanics.
runMetrics.epsFinalTooltip: Final CTE (ε_f): cross-track error at the end of the trajectory.
runMetrics.telTooltip: Elapsed time (T_el): total duration of the last trajectory run.
runMetrics.rmseJ1Tooltip: Joint 1 tracking RMSE (°): root-mean-square of θ1 position error over the run.
runMetrics.rmseJ2Tooltip: Joint 2 tracking RMSE (°): root-mean-square of θ2 position error over the run.
runMetrics.rmseEefTooltip: End-effector RMSE (mm): root-mean-square of Cartesian EEF position error over the run.
runMetrics.ctrlVarTooltip: Control Effort Variance (PWM σ²): higher values indicate more active correction. Very high values may indicate oscillation.
runMetrics.jitterTooltip: Actuator Jitter Proxy (mean |ΔPWM| per step): indicator of chattering. Lower is smoother.
